BiblicalUsage: Meroz is a place whose people stayed home when the battle came, and Deborah cursed them for it. Judges 5:23 says, Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof, because they came not to the help of the LORD against the mighty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Meroz is the warning for everyone who watches a battle and does nothing: the curse fell not for fighting on the wrong side but for not coming at all.
